notes: No SA destinations exist in the app, so all five are proposed. Meningie and Coorong National Park are separate: the park is a 110 km flagship park destination, Meningie (50 km) holds the Lower Lakes spots around Lake Albert and Raukkan; Meningie's spots are not park spots. Mannum is a separate destination from Murray Bridge (own paddle-steamer identity); Swan Reach is a locality label, so its cluster is standalone. Most spot coordinates are null (needs_research coordinates): candidates carried only town or park-centroid points. Monash Playground renamed Monash Adventure Park (wiki Monash Playground). Ninety Mile Beach (Coorong) is the one Coorong ocean-beach spot; Younghusband Peninsula was rejected as its duplicate. Karoonda renamed Karoonda Art and Sculpture Trail. Riverland span 120 km: Danggali (~89 km) and Morgan (~78 km) are at the edge; verify after pinning, else make standalone. Bio facts come from the judges' sourced reasons; Pipeline C verifies.
